input_variant.initial_state: PARENT: existing CHILD-A owns src, CHILD-T tests, CHILD-D docs. Sequence CHILD-T after CHILD-A and identify their current readiness. Do not implement or create children.

qualitative.criterion: Coordination names existing children and concrete dependencies without implementation.
qualitative.pass_example: CHILD-T depends on CHILD-A; CHILD-D has independent scope.
qualitative.fail_example: Creates an unrelated child or edits source at parent level.
